title: Y–Δ 电路：相电流与线电流
statement: 对称三相电源（正序）的线电压为 380 V，相电压 U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° ≈ 219.4∠0° V。电源向三角形（Δ）连接的对称负载供电，每相 Z = 30 + j40 Ω，端线阻抗忽略不计。电流表 A_A 串在 A 线上，测量线电流 İ_A。
求负载相电流 İ_AB 的有效值、线电流表的读数，以及 İ_A 的初相。

questions.ask: 负载相电流有效值 I_AB = ?
questions.explain: Δ 形负载每相直接接在线电压上：I_AB = 380/|30 + j40| = 380/50 = 7.6 A。

questions.ask: 线电流表 A_A 的读数 = ?
questions.explain: 对 A 点列 KCL：İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA，对称时 I_l = √3·I_p = √3 × 7.6 ≈ 13.16 A。

questions.ask: 线电流 İ_A 的初相 = ?
对称 Δ 形负载中，线电流 İ_A 与相电流 İ_AB 的关系是：
choices: İ_A = √3·İ_AB∠−30°（线电流是相电流的 √3 倍，滞后 30°）
İ_A = İ_AB（线电流等于相电流）
questions.explain: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA，İ_CA = İ_AB∠120°，所以 İ_A = İ_AB(1 − 1∠120°) = İ_AB × √3∠−30°。注意和 Y 形电源“线电压超前相电压 30°”的方向相反。

hints: Δ 形负载的每一相接在两根端线之间，承受的是线电压。先写出 U̇_AB = √3·U̇_A∠30°。
相电流 İ_AB = U̇_AB/Z；其余两相依次滞后 120°。
线电流用结点 A 的 KCL：İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA。
solution: **4. 验证。** 由一相看，İ_A 与 U̇_A 的相位差正好是阻抗角 53.13°——Δ 负载等效成 Y 形（Z_Y = Z/3 = 10 + j13.33 Ω）后，I_A = 219.4/16.67 = 13.16 A，结果一致。

en.title: Y–Δ circuit: phase and line currents
statement: A balanced three-phase source (positive sequence) has a line voltage of 380 V, i.e. phase voltage U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° ≈ 219.4∠0° V. It feeds a balanced delta (Δ) load with Z = 30 + j40 Ω per phase; the line impedance is negligible. Ammeter A_A in line A measures the line current İ_A.
Find the rms value of the load phase current İ_AB, the reading of the line ammeter, and the phase of İ_A.

questions.explain: Each phase of a Δ load is connected directly across a line voltage: I_AB = 380/|30 + j40| = 380/50 = 7.6 A.

questions.ask: Reading of the line ammeter A_A = ?
questions.explain: KCL at node A: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA; for a balanced load I_L = √3·I_p = √3 × 7.6 ≈ 13.16 A.

questions.ask: Phase of the line current İ_A = ?
For a balanced Δ load, the line current İ_A and the phase current İ_AB are related by:
choices: İ_A = √3·İ_AB∠−30° (√3 times the phase current, lagging it by 30°)
İ_A = İ_AB (line current equals phase current)
questions.explain: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA with İ_CA = İ_AB∠120°, so İ_A = İ_AB(1 − 1∠120°) = İ_AB × √3∠−30°. Note the sign is opposite to the Y-source rule “line voltage leads phase voltage by 30°”.

hints: Each phase of a Δ load sits between two lines, so it sees a line voltage. Start with U̇_AB = √3·U̇_A∠30°.
Phase current İ_AB = U̇_AB/Z; the other two lag by successive 120°.
Get the line current from KCL at node A: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA.
solution: **1. Load phase voltage = line voltage.** U̇_AB = √3 × 219.4∠(0° + 30°) = 380∠30° V.
**3. Line current (KCL).** İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA = 7.6∠−23.13° − 7.6∠96.87° = **13.16∠−53.13° A**: √3 times larger, lagging the phase current by 30°.
**4. Check.** Per phase, İ_A lags U̇_A by exactly the impedance angle 53.13° — converting the Δ load to Y (Z_Y = Z/3 = 10 + j13.33 Ω) gives I_A = 219.4/16.67 = 13.16 A, the same result.
